commands.step: Verify tag matches pyproject.toml and npm/package.json
commands.text:
PKG_VERSION=$(python3 tools/read_project_version.py pyproject.toml)
NPM_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./npm/package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "tag=${TAG_VERSION} pkg=${PKG_VERSION} npm=${NPM_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ] || [ "${NPM_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match pyproject.toml ${PKG_VERSION} / npm ${NPM_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Build sdist and wheel (pinned frontend) and twine check
commands.text:
python -m pip install --upgrade \
  pip==26.2.1 \
  build==1.5.0 \
  setuptools==84.0.0 \
  wheel==0.48.0 \
  twine==7.0.0
# --no-isolation so the pins above actually produce the metadata,
# rather than PEP 517 isolation re-fetching setuptools>=61.0 unbounded.
python -m build --no-isolation
python -m twine check dist/*
echo "preflight dist identity:"
ls -l dist
sha256sum dist/*

if ! ls dist/*.whl dist/*.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::preflight dist/ artifact is empty; refusing to publish"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PyPI publishing the preflight dist/ (not a second build):"
ls -l dist
sha256sum dist/*

commands.step: Install pinned npm in a sandbox for OIDC trusted publishing
commands.text:
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
# PINNED. This binary performs the OIDC exchange for `npm publish`
# below, so it gets the same exact-version discipline as every
# actions/* step in this file — `npm@latest` would let the registry
# pick the publish-credential binary at run time. Last verified
# 2026-09-14 (registry `latest` dist-tag at time of pin).
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@12.0.2
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./npm/package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "tag=${TAG_VERSION} pkg=${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match npm/package.json ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "::notice::npm @mcptoolshop/audiobooker@${PKG_VERSION} publishes only after PyPI job publish succeeded for the same tag (preflight dist/, not a second build)."
